label: colucci-framework-range
blockText: This appeal centres on the appropriate framework for determining applications to retroactively decrease the amount of child support owing or forgive child support arrears under s. 17 of the Divorce Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. 3 (2nd Supp .). The amount of child support payable varies based on the payor parent's income.
documentText: This appeal centres on the appropriate framework for determining applications to retroactively decrease the amount of child support owing or forgive child support arrears under s. 17 of the Divorce Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. 3 (2nd Supp .). The amount of child support payable varies based on the payor parent's income, and income often fluctuates.
